prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: production-candidate studio CGI state for a DIAL vehicle parts transition. Edit the referenced REAL photograph of a white second-generation Acura CL TWO-DOOR coupe into a precise photoreal 3D studio rendering of the SAME car. Preserve its exact two-door coupe roofline, proportions, grille, rectangular headlights, lower bumper, side glass shape, mirror, five-spoke rims and all body identity features. Same front-three-quarter camera with the nose at image right and visible left side. Remove the street, buildings, trees and registration text; place it on a charcoal-black seamless studio floor with soft realistic shadow. No extra doors, no pickup or SUV features. Exactly one tyre at each physical wheel position, no spare tyre. Landscape 16:9, whole car unobscured occupying 75% of canvas width and 60% height, with generous margins on every side for later explosion. Car center at 50% x, 52% y. No captions, no diagram labels, no UI, no decorative elements. This is a whole assembled car, not an exploded view. High-fidelity polished silver-white body materials, precise geometry, restrained cool studio light.

Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: vehicle-specific exploded category illustration, an endpoint reference for later part-layer animation. Reference image is the assembled studio CGI of a white second-generation Acura CL two-door coupe; preserve THIS car identity and nose-right front-three-quarter camera. Create a spacious exploded systems composition on uniform near-black #080b0e, landscape 16:9. Center-left upper area: the SAME white two-door body shell, with roof, glass and doors, raised slightly above a thin floorpan; remove ALL tyres from this shell, wheel arches visibly empty. Separate its hood upward and front bumper rightward slightly, keeping the coupe recognizable. Lower-left foreground: ONE left rear wheel and its small brake/suspension assembly, fully separated from its arch. Lower-center foreground: ONE left front wheel and its brake/strut assembly fully separated from its arch. Behind the shell: the two far-side wheels in their own physical positions, one at each axle, partly occluded is fine. EXACTLY FOUR tyre-and-rim assemblies in the entire scene, each unique physical wheel position appears once only. The vacated arches contain NO secondary tyre. Top-right area: one distinct representative transverse V6 engine assembly, floating clear of the shell with an ample black gap. Lower-right area: one distinct compact transverse transaxle gearbox, also separated with a black gap and clearly separate from the engine. No long pickup ladder chassis, no truck drivetrain, no additional wheels, no duplicated ghost parts. Use realistic muted silver-white CGI mechanical parts, restrained ivory outlines on central floorpan. Keep individual category groups clearly separated with at least 6% canvas gap for broad invisible click targets. NO text, NO labels, NO connectors, NO arrows, NO UI, NO watermark. Show illustrative category assemblies, not an OEM service diagram or claim of exact fitment. Full composition inside margins, never crop any detached part. This is an exploded endpoint image only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the exploded white Acura CL coupe image. Make exactly these corrections, preserving the studio background, camera, two-door coupe identity, overall category layout, nose to right, engine at top right and every unaffected part. Correction 1: replace the LONG narrow longitudinal gearbox at bottom right with a SHORT WIDE transverse FRONT-WHEEL-DRIVE automatic TRANSAXLE assembly; prominent round bell housing next to the compact parallel gear casing and integrated side differential with lateral driveshaft apertures, NO long tailshaft housing. Correction 2: the white body shell must have an OPEN BLACK ENGINE BAY because the hood is already detached above it. Remove the duplicated closed hood surface from the shell; retain its fenders and headlights bordering the empty engine bay. Correction 3: show the missing FAR-SIDE REAR wheel as a single narrow black tyre behind the shell, just above the left rear floorpan corner. Keep existing far-side front wheel in place. Total is EXACTLY FOUR tyres: front-left foreground, rear-left foreground, far-side front partly behind front of shell, far-side rear partly behind rear of shell. Never add a tyre in either empty near-side wheel arch. Exactly ONE at each physical wheel position. No repeated parts, ghost outlines, labels, arrows, text or extra mechanical assemblies. Retain large empty black gaps between the engine, transaxle, body and foreground wheels. This remains an illustrative category image, not an exact OEM parts diagram.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the exploded white Acura CL two-door coupe.
